items.problem: Agent deferred and dropped scenario9 (Override Languages) believing ResourceContext.GetForCurrentView() has no WinUI 3 desktop equivalent.
items.evidence: MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md 'scenario9.xaml.cs | getforcurrentview'; constants.cs omits Scenario9; migration-score.json 'Override Languages' verdict=fail. Working view-independent ResourceContext pattern is used by passing scenarios 7/8/10.
items.root_cause: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md #getforcurrentview stated 'None of the GetForCurrentView() patterns work in WinUI 3 desktop' with a windowing-only replacement table, giving no exit for the resource-loader/resource-context flavors; the analyzer's generic getforcurrentview signal routed them there.
items.change: Narrowed the #getforcurrentview claim to view/windowing singletons; added a 'not every GetForCurrentView is a deferral' table mapping ResourceLoader.GetForCurrentView()->new ResourceLoader() and ResourceContext.GetForCurrentView()/GetForViewIndependentUse()->new ResourceContext(); extended the Resources (MRT) section with a ResourceContext runtime qualifier-override recipe (QualifierValues/Languages, MainResourceMap.GetValue, MapChanged/Reset).
items.expected_effect: Agent migrates ResourceContext/ResourceLoader.GetForCurrentView() scenarios instead of deferring them.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, scenario9 (Override Languages) is present in constants.cs and reachable; the migration-score 'Override Languages' feature goes fail->pass; scenario9.xaml.cs is not listed in MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md.

items.problem: In-app image/file resource variants were not carried over; scenario2 images render blank.
items.evidence: Migrated project has no Images/ tree or projector*.png; source variants live in shared/images/ (en-US/, ja/, .scale-*/.contrast-*). migration-score.json scenario2 verdict=partial.
items.root_cause: Skill only covers reconciling manifest Assets/ logos; no guidance to carry in-app qualifier-variant resources (Image Source / ms-appx), which UWP SDK samples store in a shared/ sibling folder.
items.change: Added an 'In-app image & file resource variants' subsection: copy the full qualifier-variant tree (incl. from shared/) as Build Action=Content and verify every Image Source / ms-appx path resolves; noted that a missing variant tree renders blank, not a build error.
items.expected_effect: Agent copies the image/file resource variant tree so MRT resolves them at runtime.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, the migrated project contains the Images/ variant tree and scenario2's two Image controls render the projector images (partial->pass).

items.problem: The analyzer's generic getforcurrentview signal injected a TODO pointing only at the windowing section for resource-context/loader hits.
items.evidence: unsupported-api-inventory.json had a single '\bGetForCurrentView\s*\(' -> 'getforcurrentview' adaptable entry.
items.root_cause: No specific routing for the resource flavors, so the injected TODO led the agent to the windowing-only guidance.
items.change: Added two more-specific adaptable entries (ResourceLoader.GetForCurrentView and ResourceContext.GetForCurrentView/GetForViewIndependentUse) ordered before the generic entry, routing their injected TODO to the #resources-mrt anchor.
items.expected_effect: The inline TODO for resource-context/loader points at the resources section that explains the direct replacement, reinforcing the prose fix (can't be ignored).
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, files using ResourceContext/ResourceLoader.GetForCurrentView carry a TODO 'see PATTERNS.md#resources-mrt' and are labeled migrate-with-adaptation, not defer.
